articles.summary: Transaction advances portfolio simplification and supports capital deployment priorities Algonquin Power Utilities Corp. (TSX/NYSE: AQN) ("AQN", "Algonquin" or the "Company") today announced that it has completed the previously announced sale of its approximately 64% ownership interest in Chilean water utility Suralis S.A. ("Suralis") to a fund managed by Toesca S.A. Administradora General de Fondos ("Toesca"). The transaction was originally announced on August 28, 2026. articles.title: Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. Completes Sale of Ownership Stake in Chilean Utility
